notes: QuantumToken in src/QuantumToken.sol has a parameterless constructor that mints 1,000,000,000 QUANTUM with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. It has no post-deployment minting, transfer fees, administrative powers or initialization calls. No application contracts are required. The native ETH pool uses the permitted 0.3% fee tier with tick spacing 60. Native ETH sorts as currency0 and QUANTUM as currency1, so the provenance sqrtPriceX96 is sqrt(1000000000000000000000000000 / 10000000000000000000) * 2^96 = 792281625142643375935439503360000. The deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
